text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Sato-chan, are you okay?
Are you tired, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, I'm fine.
I'm sorry, I was just spacing out a little...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Since you went out of your way to invite me, I'm going to enjoy myself to the fullest today!

text_block_list.name: Arcade Employee
text_block_list.text:
――C-Customer... Please, customer!
P-Please spare me from any more of this...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
S-Sato-chan, Sato-chan! Pull yourself together!
You already won all the prizes!
The battle is already over!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Huh!?
W-Wait? What was I doing...?

With a packed race schedule lately,
Satono Diamond seems to be accumulating fatigue,
even though she tries not to show it...
